sharedObservations: All three action galleries and all three portrait galleries were visually inspected.
The visible sprites have no unintended colored halo or clipped hands, headwear, antenna tips or feet.
Attack arcs, ground shadows and stance/action markers visible in the galleries are production-rendered effects; the native image assets remain unchanged.

The actual source-canvas checks verify the installed authored files, both orientations and uniform scaling. Three supplementary scenes verify six further authored stance draws and preserve simulation state.
limitations: Production Canvas2D modules were run in Node with native Skia; no browser, DOM, input, audio, service-worker or physical-device test was executed.
The 60 directed draw checks cover 27 action files and 3 stance files in both orientations; 3 selection portraits are reviewed separately. They are not 60 distinct new drawings.
Single static action drawings do not establish complete animation cycles.
Rendering and visual readability do not certify canonical 1:1 costume or episode fidelity.
Only the three recorded static pair scenes were reviewed; no claim is made about an entire interactive match.
